content: OSMD renders MusicXML via VexFlow and exposes a logical/graphical split: Note (pitch, Length.RealValue in beats) lives in the score model; GraphicalNote is reachable via osmd.rules.GNote(note) or osmd.cursor.GNotesUnderCursor(), and GraphicalNote.getSVGGElement() returns the actual SVG <g> element for a notehead, which can be recolored/hidden in place without a full re-render. Note onset timing comes from MusicPartManagerIterator.currentTimeStamp.realValue (beats at 60bpm baseline), converted to seconds via realValue * 4 * (60/bpm).
